name: tmi-blockchain-certificate-platform
description: TMI Group blockchain-verifiable digital asset certificate platform

scripts.format: npm run format:root && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:root: prettier --write --ignore-unknown .github contracts frontend infrastructure tests README.md SECURITY.md compose.yaml package.json .env.example .editorconfig .gitattributes .gitignore .node-version .npmrc .nvmrc .prettierignore .prettierrc.json .python-version
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:root && npm run format:check:backend
scripts.format:check:root: prettier --check --ignore-unknown .github contracts frontend infrastructure tests README.md SECURITY.md compose.yaml package.json .env.example .editorconfig .gitattributes .gitignore .node-version .npmrc .nvmrc .prettierignore .prettierrc.json .python-version
scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:root && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
